adjudication.depicted_input: Classification fine-tuning path showing DNA sequence tokenization/task-unified classification input into Omni-DNA, with the classification task panel and shared tokenizer/interface beneath it.
adjudication.rationale: The current source figure is defensible for the single-task classification route because it visibly shows the classification input mechanism: DNA sequence tokens are tokenized and fed into Omni-DNA for a classification task during fine-tuning. Under the atlas rules, a shared architecture figure can support a named variant from the same paper when the depicted input mechanism matches, and the exact variant name or classifier head need not be shown. A tighter crop centered on the classification branch is better than the full figure because it removes unrelated pretraining/function-prediction/DNA2Images content while preserving the route-specific input/interface.
